G0600.def:
ἀπο-καθ-ίστημι (ἀποκαθιστάω, Mc 9:12, Rec., -ιστάνω, LTTr.; cf. At 1:6; -κατιστάνω, WH),
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
__1. to restore, i.e. to a former condition: of health, Mt 12:13, Mc 3:5 8:25, Lc 6:10; of social or political affairs, Mt 17:11, Mc 9:12, At 1:6.
__2. to give back, bring back: Hb 13:19 (so in π., MM, see word; cf. also Cremer, 312).†
(AS)

G0601.def:
ἀπο-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ]
__1. in general sense (cl.), to reveal, uncover, disclose,
__(a) of things: Mt 10:26, Lc 2:35 12:2, 1Co 3:13;
__(b) of persons: pass., Christ, Lc 17:30; Antichrist, 2Ts 2:3 2:6 2:8
__2. In LXX and NT, in special sense of divine revelation: Mt 11:25 (on the tense, see M, Pr., 136), ib. Mt 11:27 16:17, Lc 10:21-22, Jo 12:38, Rm 1:17-18 8:18, 1Co 2:10 14:30, Gl 1:16 3:23, Ef 3:5, Fp 3:15, 1Pe 1:5-12 5:1 (Westc., Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 149 f.).†
SYN.: φανερόω (see Thayer, 62; Cremer, 342).† (AS)

G0602.def:
ἀπο-κάλυψις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκαλύπτω), [in LXX: 1Rs 20:30 (עֶרְוָה), Sir.11:27 22:22 42:1 * ;]
an uncovering, laying bare (Plut.). Metaphorical, a reveal­ing, revelation: a disclosure of divine truth, or a manifestion from God: Lc 2:32 Rm 2:5 8:19 16:25, 1Co 1:7 14:6 14:26, 2Co 12:1 12:7, Gl 1:12 2:2, Ef 1:17 3:3 2Ts 1:7 1Pe 1:7 1:13 4:13, Ap 1:1.†
SYN.: ἐπιφάνεια, παρουσία, φανέρωσις (see Tr., Syn., xciv; Lft., Notes, 102, 178; Westc, Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 145 ff.; Cremer, 343) (AS)

G0603.def:
ἀπο-καραδοκία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀποκαραδοκέω, used by Aq. in Sl 37:7 for חוּל; ἀπό, κάρα the head, δοκέω, in Ion., to watch),
to watch with outstretched head, watch anxiously (Polyb., π.; see Deiss., LAE, 374.5, 377 f.), Rm 8:19, Fp 1:20 (Lft., in l; Cremer, 177).†
(AS)

G0604.def:
ἀπο-κατ-αλλάσσω
(cf. καταλλάσσω: ἀπό here signifies completely, see Lft., Col., l.with; Ellic., Eph., l.with; but also Mey., Eph., l.with),
to reconcile completely: Ef 2:16, Cl 1:20-21.†
(AS)

G0605.def:
ἀπο-κατά-στασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκαθίστημι),
restoration: At 3:21 (in τ. of repairs and restorations of temples, see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0606.def:
ἀπό-κειμαι
[in LXX: Gn 49:10 (שִׁילֹה), Jó 38:23 (חָשַׂךְ), 2Ma.12:45, 4Ma.8:11 * ;]
to be laid up, in store, laid away: Lc 19:20. Metaphorical, C. dative of person(s), to be reserved (Dem., Plat.; and see MM, see word): Cl 1:5, 2Tm 4:8, Hb 9:27.†
(AS)

G0607.def:
ἀπο-κεφαλίζω
(ἀπό, κεφαλή), [in LXX: Sl 151:7 * ;]
to behead: Mt 14:10, Mc 6:16, 28 Lc 9:9.†
(AS)

G0608.def:
ἀπο-κλείω
[in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;]
to shut fast: Lc 13:25.†
(AS)

G0609.def:
ἀπο-κόπτω
[in LXX for קָצַץ, כָּרַת, etc. ;]
to cut off: Mc 9:43, 45, Jo 18:10, 26 At 27:32. Mid., to mutilate oneself, have oneself mutilated: Gl 5:12 (cf. Dt 23:1 LXX; and see Cremer, 751; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0610.def:
ἀπό-κριμα, -τος, τό
(ἀποκρίνω);
__1. prop., a judicial sentence: 2Co 1:9, R, mg.
__2. an answer (see Thayer, see word): 2Co 1:9, R, txt. (In FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 6, of a rescript of the Senate; in Inscr. of an official decision, Deiss., BS, 257; a reply to a deputation, MM, see word: cf. also Cremer, 3'75).†
(AS)

G0611.def:
ἀποκρίνω, ἀποκρίνομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for ענה ;]
in cl.,
__1. to separate, distinguish.
__2. to choose.
Mid., to answer: Mt 27:12, Mc 14:61, Lc 3:16 23:9, Jo 5:17, 19 At 3:12. In late Gk. the pass, also is used in this sense, and pass. forms are the more frequently in NT (M, Pr., 39, 161; MM, see word);
__(a) in general sense: absol., Mc 12:34; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 22:46; with dative of person(s), Mt 12:38; before πρός, At 25:16;
__(b) Hebraistically
__(i) like ענה, to begin to speak, take up the conversation (Kennedy, Sources, 124f.): Mt 11:25, al.,
__(ii) redundant, as in the Heb. phrase וַיַּעַן וַיּאֹמֶר (Dalman, Words, 24f., 38; M, Pr., 14; Bl., §58, 4; 74, 2; Cremer, 374): ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπε, Mt 4:4; ἔφη, 8:8; λέγει, Mc 3:33; in Jo most frequently (ἀπεκ. κ. εἶπε, 1:49. )
(AS)

G0612.def:
ἀπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποκρίνομαι), [in LXX for דָּבָר, etc. ;]
an answering, an answer: Lc 2:47 20:26, Jo 1:22 19:9.†
(AS)

G0613.def:
ἀπο-κρύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;]
to hide, conceal, keep secret: with accusative, Lc 10:21; pass., 1Co 2:7, Ef 3:9, Cl 1:26 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0614.def:
ἀπόκρυφος, -ον
(ἀποκρύπτω), [in LXX Chiefly for סֵתֶר ;]
hidden: Mc 4:22, Lc 8:17, Cl 2:3 (see Lft., in l; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0615.def:
ἀπο-κτείνω
(also in late forms -κτέννω, Mt 10:28, a1., LTTr., -κτεννύω, Mc 12:5, WH), [in LXX for הָרַג, מוּת ;]
to kill: Mt 14:5, al.; before instr. ἐν (which see), Ef 2:16, Ap 2:23, al. Metaphorical: Rm 7:11; τ. ἔχθραν, Ef 2:16; τὸ γράμμα ἀποκτείνει 2Co 3:6 (on the perfective force of this verb, see M, Pr., 114)
(AS)

G0616.def:
ἀπο-κυέω
(Rec. -κύω), -ῶ (ἀπό, κυέω or κύω, to be pregnant), [in LXX: 4Ma.15:17 * ;]
prop., "the medical word for birth as the close of pregnancy" (Hort, Ja., 26 f.). In κοιν, "an ordinary syn. of τίκτω, but definitely 'perfectivised' (M, Pr., 111 ff.; MM, see word) by the
ἀπό, and so implying safe delivery," to bring forth, give birth to: Tg 1:15, 18.†
(AS)

G0617.def:
ἀπο-κυλίω
(see: κυλίω), [in LXX: Gn 29:3, 8 29:10 (גָּלַל) Jdth.13:9 * ;]
to roll away: Mt 28:2, Mc 16:3, Lc 24:2.†
(AS)

G0618.def:
ἀπο-λαμβάνω
[in LXX: Nm 34:14 (לָקַח (Dt 25:5 A, Is 5:17, 2Ma.4:46 2Mac 6:21 2Mac 8:6, 4Ma.18:23 * ;]
__1. to receive from another; absol., to receive as one's due: Lc 16:25 18:30 (seel. λάβῃ) Lc 23:41, Rm 1:27, Gl 4:5, Cl 3:24, 2Jn.8.
__2. to receive back: Lc 6:34 15:27.
__3. to take apart or aside: Mc 7:33 (cf. use in π. of the recluses of the Serapeum; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0619.def:
ἀπόλαυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπολαύω, to take of, enjoy a thing) [in LXX: 3Ma.7:16 * ;]
enjoyment: 1Tm 6:17, Hb 11:26 (for late exx., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0620.def:
ἀπο-λείπω
[in LXX for H2308 יָתַר, etc. ;]
__1. to leave, leave behind (in π. a term. techn. in wills; see MM, see word): 2Tm 4:13 4:20, Tt 1:5; pass., to be reserved, remain: Hb 4:6, 9 10:26.
__2. to desert, abandon: Ju 6.†
(AS)

G0621.def:
ἀπο-λείχω
(for ἐπιλ-, which see),
to lick up: Lc 16:21, Rec.†
(AS)

G0622.def:
ἀπ-όλλυμι and ἀπολλύω
[in LXX for אָבַד, etc. (38 words in all)].
__1. Act.,
__1 to destroy utterly, destroy, kill: Mk 124, 922, al.; τ. ψνχήν, Mt 10:28, al.;
__2 to lose utterly: Mt 10:42, al.; metaphorically, of failing to save, Jo 6:39 18:9.
__2. Mid.,
__1 to perish;
__(a) of things: Mt 5:29, Jo 6:12, Hb 1:11 (LXX, al.;
__(b) of persons: Mt 8:26, al. Metaphorical, of loss of eternal life, Jo 3:15-16 10:28 17:12, Rm 2:12, 1Co 8:11 15:18, 2Pe 3:9. In οἱ ἀπολλὺμενοι, the perishing, contrasted in 1Co 1:18, al., with οἱ σωζόμενοι, the "perfective" force of the verb, WH. " implies the completion of the process of destruction," is illustrated (see M, Pr., 114 f.; M, Th., ii, 2:10);
__2 to be lost: Lc 15:4 21:18. Metaphorical, on the basis of the relation between shepherd and flock, of spiritual destitution and alienation from God: Mt 10:6 15:24, Lc 19:10 (MM, see word; DCG, i, 191 f., ii, 76, 554; Cremer, 451)
(AS)

G0623.def:
Ἀπολλύων, -οντος, ὁ
(present ptcp. of ἀπολλύω),
Apollyon, i.e. the Destroyer: Ap 9:11 (cf. Ἀβάδδων). (Cremer, 453; DB, i, 125, 172.) †
(AS)

G0624.def:
Ἀπολλωνία, -ας, ἡ
Apollonia, a city of Macedonia: At 17:1.†
(AS)

G0625.def:
Ἀπολλώς, -ώ, ὁ
(perh. contr. from Ἀπολλώνιος, At 18:24 D)
Apollos: At 18:24 19:1, 1Co 1:12 3:4-6 3:22 4:6 16:12, Tt 3:13.†
(AS)

G0626.def:
ἀπολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἀπό, λόγος), [in LXX: Jr 12:1 (רִיב) Jr 31:6, 2Ma.13:26 * ;]
__1. to defend: with accusative, Rm 2:15.
__2. to defend one's self: absol., Lc 21:14, At 26:1; before ὅτι, At 25:8; τί, to adduce something in one's defence, Lc 12:11, At 26:24 (ταῦτα) At 24:10 (τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ); περί, with genitive of thing(s), and ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), At 26:2; with dative of person(s), At 19:33, 2Co 12:19.†
(AS)

G0627.def:
ἀπολογία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπολογέομαι), [in LXX: Wis.6:10 * ;]
a speech in defence: At 25:16, 2Co 7:11, Fp 1:7, 16, 2Tm 4:16; with dative of person(s), 1Co 9:3, 1Pe 3:15; before πρός, At 22:1.†
(AS)

G0628.def:
ἀπο-λούω
[in LXX: Jó 9:30 (רָחַץ)* ;]
to wash off, wash away; mid., metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), to wash off oneself: ἀμαρτίας, At 22:16; absol., ἀπελούσασθε, ye washed yourselves clean (cf. Cremer, 406), 1Co 6:11.†
(AS)

G0629.def:
ἀπο-λύτρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπολυτρόω, to release on payment of ransom, cf. λύτρον), [in LXX: Da (LXX) Dn 4:30 with * ;]
release effected by pay­ment of ransom, redemption, deliverance; metaphorically, Hb 11:35; of deliverance thr. Christ from evil and the consequences of sin: Lc 21:28, Rm 3:24 (Vau., in l) 8:23, 1Co 1:30, Ef 1:7, 14 4:30, Cl 1:14, Hb 9:15. (On the extent to WH. the word retains the sense of ransom, see ICC, Rm 3:24, Westc., He., 297 ff.; see also ICC, Eph., 11; DCG, ii, 605; Cremer, 410; Deiss., LAE, 331; Lft., Notes, 271, 316; Tr., Syn., § 77.)†
(AS)

G0630G.def:
ἀπο-λύω
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;]
__1. to set free, release: Lc 13:12, Jo 19:10, al.; a debtor, Mt 18:27; metaphorically, of forgive­ness, Lc 6:37.
__2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): Mt 15:23, Lc 2:29 9:12, At 19:41, al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: Mt 1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10 Mc 10:2, 4 10:11, Lc 16:18; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: Mc 10:12. Mid., to depart: At 28:25 (MM, see word)
(AS)

G0630H.def:
ἀπο-λύω
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;]
__1. to set free, release: Lc 13:12, Jo 19:10, al.; a debtor, Mt 18:27; metaphorically, of forgive­ness, Lc 6:37.
__2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): Mt 15:23, Lc 2:29 9:12, At 19:41, al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: Mt 1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10 Mc 10:2, 4 10:11, Lc 16:18; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: Mc 10:12. Mid., to depart: At 28:25 (MM, see word)
(AS)

G0631.def:
απο-μάσσω
(μάσσω, Att... -ττω, to touch, handle), [in LXX: Tob.7:17 * ;]
to wipe off, wire clean: mid., Lc 10:11.†
(AS)

G0632.def:
ἀπο-νέμω
(νέμω, to distribute), [in LXX: Dt 4:19 (חָלַק), 3Ma.1:7 3Mac 3:16 * ;]
to assign, apportion: 1Pe 3:7. (In π. of a Prefect who renders to all their dues; see MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0633.def:
ἀπο-νίπτω
[in LXX for שָׁטַף, רָחַץ, מָחָה ;]
to wash off: mid. (reflex.), τ. χεῖρας, Mt 27:24.†
(AS)

G0634.def:
ἀπο-πίπτω
[in LXX for מָלַל, נָפַל, etc. ;]
to fall off: At 9:18.†
(AS)

G0635.def:
ἀπο-πλανάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָדַח hi., נָטָה hi., שׁוּב pi. ;]
to cause to go astray; metaphorically, of leading into error: Mc 13:22; pass., to be led astray: 1Tm 6:10.†
(AS)

G0638.def:
ἀπο-πνίγω
[in LXX: Na 2:13 (חָנַק pi.), Tob.3:8 * ;]
to choke: Mt 13:7, Lc 8:7; pass., of drowning (= καταποντίζομαι), Lc 8:33.†
(AS)

G0639.def:
ἀπορέω, -ῶ
(ἄπορος, ἀ- neg., πόρος, a way, resource), [in LXX for צָרַר, מוּךְ, etc. ;]
to be at a loss, be perplexed: absol., Mc 6:20 (ἐποίει, R, mg.); mid., be in doubt: absol., 2Co 4:8; with accusative, At 25:20; before περί, Lc 24:4; ἐν, Gl 4:20; περὶ τίνος λέγει, Jo 13:22.†
SYN.: διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, διστάζω, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491) (AS)

G0640.def:
ἀπορία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπορέω), [in LXX for בֶּהָלָה, etc. ;]
perplexity: Lc 21:25 (MM, see word; on the construction, see Field, Notes, 74 f.).†
(AS)

G0641.def:
ἀπο-ρίπτω
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, c1.), [in LXX for שָׁלַךְ hi., etc. ;]
to throw away, cast forth: reflexively, At 27:43 (BV, cast themselves overboard; see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0642.def:
ἀπ-ορφανίζω
(ἀπό, ὀρφανός),
to be bereaved (prop., of a parent, Lft., Notes, 36); metaphorically, 1Ts 2:17 (where Field thinks it = χωρισθέντες, Notes, 199).†
(AS)

G0643.def:
ἀπο-σκευάζω
[in LXX: Lv 14:36 (פָּנָה pi.) * ;]
to pack and carry off; mid., to pack and remove one's goods: At 21:15, Rec. (see ἐπισ-).†
ἐπι-σκευάζω,
[in LXX for pm pi., etc. ;]
to equip, make ready; mid., to make one's preparations: At 21:15.†
(AS)

G0644.def:
ἀπο-σκίασμα, -τος, τό
(ἀποσκιάζω, to cast a shadow; v,s. σκία)
a shadow: Tg 1:17 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0645.def:
ἀπο-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָתַק: ni., hi., etc. ;]
to draw off or away, tear away (MM, see word): At 20:30; μάχαιραν, draw a sword, Mt 26:51; pass., to be parted or withdrawn (Field, Notes, 134; but see Thayer, see word), Lc 22:41, At 21:1.†
(AS)

G0646.def:
άποστασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀφίστημι), [in LXX for מַעַל, etc. ;]
defection, apostasy, revolt; in late Gk. (MM, Exp., viii; Lft., Notes, 111; Cremer, 308) for cl. ἀπόστασις, frequently in sense of political revolt, in LXX (e.g. Js 22:22, 2Cr 29:19, Jr 2:19) and NT always of religious apostasy: At 21:21, 2Ts 2:3.†
(AS)

G0647.def:
ἀποστάσιον, -ου, τό
(ἀφίστημι), [in LXX; Dt 24:1, 3, Jr 3:8, Is 50:1 (כְּרִיתוּת) * ;]
__1. in cl., only in phrase ἀποστασίου δίκη, an action against a freedman for forsaking his προστάτης (Dem.).
__2. In LXX, βιβλίον ἀποστασίου, a bill of divorce: Mt 19:7, Mc 10:4; in same sense ἀ. alone (MM, see word), Mt 5:31 (for other late exx., see MM, l.with; Kennedy, Sources, 121).†
(AS)

G0649.def:
ἀπο-στέλλω,
[in LXX very freq., almost always for שׁלח ;]
prop., to send away, to dispatch on service;
__1. to send with a commission, or on service;
__(a) of persons: Christ, Mt 10:40; the apostles, 10:16; servants, Mc 12:2; angels, 13:27;
__(b) of things: ὄνος, Mt 21:3; τὸ δρέπανον, Mc 4:29; τ. λόγον, At 10:36; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν (i.e. the promised Holy Spirit), Lc 24:49, Rec.; before εἰς, Mt 20:2, Lc 11:49, Jo 3:17; ὀπίσω, Lc 19:14; ἔμπροσθεν, Jo 3:28; πρὸ προσώπου, Mt 11:10; πρός, Mt 21:34; with ref. to sender or place of departure: ἀπό, Lc 1:26 (Rec. ὑπό); παρά, Jo 1:6; ἐκ, ib. 1:19; ὑπό, At 10:17 (Rec. ἀπό); before inf., Mc 3:14, al.; ἵνα, Mc 12:2, al.; εἰς (of purpose), Hb 1:14; without direct obj.: before πρός, Jo 5:33; λέγων, Jo 11:3; ἀποστείλας, with indic., Mt 2:16, At 7:14, Ap 1:1.
__2. to send away, dismiss: Lc 4:18, Mc 5:10 8:26 12:3 (cf. ἐξ-, συν-αποστέλλω).
SYN.: πέμπω, the general term. ἀ. "suggests official or authoritative sending" (see Thayer, see word πέμπω; Westc., Jo., 298; Epp. Jo., 125; Cremer, 529; MM, see word). (AS)

G0650.def:
ἀπο-στερέω, -ῶ
(στερέω, to rob), [in LXX: Êx 21:10 (גָּרַע), Dt 24:14 (עָשַׁק), Ml 3:5, Sir.4:1 29:6-7 31:21-22 * ;]
to defraud, deprive of, despoil (in cl. chiefly of the misappropriation of trust funds, Field, Notes, 33; cf. MM, see word): absol., Mc 10:19, 1Co 6:8; with accusative of person(s), 1Co 7:5. Mid., endure deprivation: 1Co 6:7 (WM, § 38, 3; but see Bl., § 54, 5; M, Pr., 162); pass., ἀπεστερημένοι, bereft of: 1Tm 6:5.†
(AS)

G0651.def:
ἀπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποστέλλω), [in LXX: Dt 22:7, 3Ki.4:34 9:16 Sl 78:49, Ec 8:8, Ct 4:13 (for שָׁלַח and its cognates), 1Es.9:51 Et 9:54, Jr 32:36, Bar.2:25, 1Ma.2:18, 2Ma.3:2 *.]
__1. In cl., a sending away (MM, see word), as, an expedition (Hdt.).
__2. In LXX
__(a) discharge, dis­missal (Ec 8:8);
__(b) a gift (3Ki.9:16, 1Ma.2:13).
__3. In NT, the office of an Apostle of Christ, apostleship: At 1:25, Rm 1:5, 1Co 9:2, Gl 2:8 (Cremer, 530).†
(AS)

G0652.def:
ἀπόστολος, -ου, ὁ
(ἀοστέλλω), [in LXX; 3Ki.14:6 A (שָׁלַח) * ;]
__1. a fleet, an expedition (Dem.).
__2. a messenger, one sent on a mission (Hdt., LXX, l.with, and π.; see M, Pr., 37 f.; MM, see word; M, Th., i, 2:7 and reff.): Jo 13:16, 2Co 8:23 Fp 2:25.
__3. In NT, an Apostle of Christ
__(a) with special ref. to the Twelve: Mt 10:2, Mc 3:14, Lc 11:49, Ef 3:5, Ap 18:20, al., equality with whom is claimed by St. Paul, Gl 1:1, 11 ff, 1Tm 2:7, a1.;
__(b) in a wider sense of prominent Christian teachers, as Barnabas, At 14:14, apparently also Silvanus and Timothy, 1Ts 2:6, and perhaps Andronicus and Junias (Junia?), Rm 16:7 (see ICC, in l); of false teachers, claiming apostleship: 2Co 11:5 11:13, Ap 2:2. (On the different uses of the term in NT, see Lit., Gal., 92-101; Cremer, 530; DB, i, 126; DCG, i, 105; Enc. Br., ii, 196 ff.)
(AS)

G0653.def:
ἀποστοματίζω
(στόμα),
__1. In cl., to speak from memory, to dic­tate to a pupil (Plat.).
__2. In late Gk., to catechize, question: Lc 11:53 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0654.def:
ἀπο-στρέφω
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
trans., with accusative,
__(a) to turn away, remove: Rm 11:26, 2Tm 4:4; metaphorically, to turn away from allegiance, pervert: Lc 23:14;
__(b) to turn back, return: μάχαιραν, Mt 26:52. Pass., reflex., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, Mt 5:42, 2Tm 1:15, Tt 1:14, Hb 12:25; so act., absol., At 3:26 (cf. Sir.8:5; Bl., § 53, 1; Cremer, 880).†
(AS)

G0657.def:
ἀπο-τάσσω
[in LXX: Ec 2:20 (יָאַשׁ pi.), I Et 6:27, Jr 20:2, 1-18; 1Ma.4:1-61 * ;]
to set apart. Mid., in late Gk. (El., § 37, 1; Swete, Mk., 136 f.; MM, e. dative,
__(a) to take leave of: Mc 6:46, Lc 9:61, At 18:18, 21, 2Co 2:13;
__(b) to forsake: Lc 14:33.†
(AS)

G0658.def:
ἀπο-τελέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Et 5:73, 1Ma.15:39 * ;]
to bring to an end, complete, accomplish (cf. MM, see word): Lc 13:32, Tg 1:15.†
(AS)

G0659.def:
ἀπο-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ hi. ;]
to put off or aside; in NT always mid.,
__(a) to put of from oneself as a garment: τ. ἱμάτια, At 7:58; metaphorically, in ethical sense, to put of, lay aside: Rm 13:12, Ef 4:22, 25, Cl 3:8, Hb 12:1, Tg 1:21, 1Pe 2:1;
__(b) to stow away, put: ἐν τ. φυλακῇ (MM, see word), Mt 14:3.†
(AS)

G0660.def:
ἀπο-τινάσσω
[in LXX: Jz 16:20 A (נָעַר ni.), 1Rs 10:2 (נָטַשׁ), La 2:7 (נָאַר pi.) * ;]
to shake of: Lc 9:5, At 28:5.†
(AS)

G0661.def:
ἀπο-τίνω (or -τίω)
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם pi. ;]
to pay off, repay: Phm 19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0662.def:
ἀπο-τολμάω, -ῶ
to be quite bold, make a bold venture: Rm 10:20.†
(AS)

G0663.def:
ἀποτομία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀποτέμνω, to cut of), [in Sm.: Jr 51:35, Na 3:1 * ;]
steepness, sharpness; metaphorically, severity (MM, see word): Rm 11:22.†
(AS)

G0664.def:
ἀποτόμως
adv., [in LXX: Wis.5:22 * ;]
abruptly, curtly, hence sharply, severely: 2Co 13:10, Tt 1:13 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0665.def:
ἀπο-τρέπω
[in LXX: Sir.20:29 48:18, 3Ma.1:23, 4Ma.1:33 4Mac 16:12 * ;]
to turn away; mid., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, 2Tm 3:5.†
(AS)

G0666.def:
ἀπουσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄπειμι);
__1. absence (Æsch., Thuc.): Fp 2:12,
__2. deficiency, waste (MM, s.v).†
(AS)

G0667.def:
ἀπο-φέρω
[in LXX for הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
to carry off, bear, or lead away: with accusative, Mc 15:1, 1Co 16:3, Ap 17:3 21:10. Pass., Lc 16:22, At 19:12.†
(AS)

G0668.def:
ἀπο-φεύγω
[in LXX: Sir.22:22 * ;]
to flee from, escape: with accusative, 2Pe 2:18 2:20; with genitive, 2Pe 1:4.†
(AS)

G0669.def:
ἀπο-φθέγγομαι
[in LXX for נָבָא, etc. ;]
to speak forth, give utterance: At 2:4, 14 26:25 (MM, s. see).†
(AS)

G0670.def:
ἀπο-φορτίζομαι
(φορτίζω, to load),
to discharge a cargo (Field, Notes, 134), to unlade: with accusative, τ. γόμον, At 21:3.†
(AS)

G0671.def:
ἀπό-χρησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποχράομαι, to use to the full, abuse)
abuse, misuse: Cl 2:22 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0672.def:
ἀπο-χωρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jr 46:5 (סוּג), 2Ma.4:33, 3Ma.2:33 * ;]
to go away, depart, withdraw: before ἀπό, Mt 7:23, Lc 9:39, At 13:13 (absol., Lc 20:20, Tr., mg.).†
(AS)

G0673.def:
ἀπο-χωρίζω
[in LXX: Eze.43:21 (מִפְקָד)* ;]
to separate, part asunder: pass., Ap 6:14; reflexively, to separate oneself: At 15:39.†
(AS)

G0674.def:
ἀπο-ψύχω
[in LXX: 4Ma.15:18 * ;]
__1. to breathe out life, expire (Thue.; LXX, l.with).
__2. to leave off breathing, faint (Hom., Od., xxiv, 348): before ἀπό, Lc 21:26.†
(AS)

G0675.def:
Ἀππιος, -ου, ὁ
Appius; Ἀππίου Φόρον, Appii Forum (Market of Appius), a town in Italy: At 28:15.†
(AS)

G0677.def:
ἀπρόσκοπος, -ον
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.32:21, 3Ma.3:8 * ;]
__1. act., not causing to stumble: metaphorically, of not leading others into sin, 1Co 10:32.
__2. Pass., not stumbling, without offence, blameless: At 24:16, Fp 1:10 (for exx., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0678.def:
ἀπροσωπολήμπτως (Rec. -λήπτως, cl.), adv.
(α- neg., προσωπολήμπτης),
without respect of persons, impartially: 1Pe 1:17.†
(AS)

G0679.def:
ἄ-πταιστος, -ον
(πταίω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:39 * ;]
without stumbling, sure-footed: metaphorically (MM, see word), Ju 24.†
(AS)

G0681.def:
ἅπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַע ;]
prop., to fasten to; hence, of fire, to kindle, light: Lc 8:16 11:33 15:8, At 28:2. Mid., with genitive, to fasten oneself to, cling to, lay hold of (so in π.; MM, see word): Mt 8:3, 15, Jo 20:17, al.; of carnal intercourse, 1Co 7:1; with reference to levitical and ceremonial prohibitions, 2Co 6:17, Cl 2:21; of hostile action, 1Jo 5:18 (cf. ἀν-, καθ-, περι- άπτω)
SYN.: θιγγάνω, ψηλαφάω. ἅ. is the stronger, θ., to touch, the lighter term. ψ. is to feel, as in search of something (Tr., Syn., § xvii; Lft., Col., 201 f.) (AS)

G0683.def:
ἀπ-ωθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for זָנַח, מָאַס, etc. ;]
to thrust away. Mid., to thrust away from oneself, refuse, reject: with accusative of person(s) (MM, see word), At 7:27, 39 13:46, Rm 11:1-2, 1Tm 1:19.†
(AS)

G0684.def:
ἀπώλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀπόλλυμι), [in LXX (Cremer, 797) for אָבַד, אֵיד, etc. ;]
destruction, waste, loss, perishing (in π., of money, see MM, see word): Mt 26:8, Mc 14:4, At 8:20, Rm 9:22, 1Tm 6:9, 2Pe 2:1; in special sense of the loss of eternal life, perdition, the antithesis of σωτηρία: Mt 7:13, Jo 17:12, Fp 1:28 3:19, 2Ts 2:3, Hb 10:39, 2Pe 2:3 3:7 3:16, Ap 17:8, 11 (DB, iii, 744).†
(AS)

G0685.def:
ἀρά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אָלָה ];
__1. a prayer (MM, see word).
__2. (as in Homer) a curse, malediction: Rm 3:14 (LXX),†
(AS)

G0686.def:
ἄρα,
illative particle, expressing a more subjective or informal inference than οὖν,
then: prop. (as in cl.), the second word in the sentence, Rm 7:21 8:1, Gl 3:7; ἐπεὶ ἄρα, 1Co 7:14 (with another word between) 5:10; as the first word, Lc 11:48, At 11:18, Rm 10:17, 1Co 15:18, 2Co 5:15 7:12, Hb 4:9; so prop. in apodosis after protasis with εἰ, Mt 12:28, Lc 11:20, Gl 2:21 3:29 5:11, Hb 12:8 (κενὸν ἄρα), 1Co 15:14; often in interrogations, direct and indirect, τίς (τί) ἄρα, Mt 18:1 19:25, 27 24:45, Mc 4:41, Lc 1:66 8:25 12:42 22:23, At 12:18; εἰ ἄρα, Mc 11:13, At 8:22; εἴπερ ἄρα, 1Co 15:15; οὐκ ἄρα, At 21:38; μήτι ἄρα, 2Co 1:17; in strengthened forms, ἄρα γε, ἄραγε, Mt 7:20 17:26, At 17:27, and more frequently ἄρα οὖν (Epp. Paul.), so then, Rm 5:18 7:3, 25 8:12 9:16, 18 14:19, Gl 6:10, Ef 2:19, 1Ts 5:6, 2Ts 2:15 (Bl., §77, 2; 78, 5; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0687.def:
ἆρα,
interrog. particle,
implying anxiety or impatience, "quite rare and only in Luke and Paul, therefore a literary word" (Bl., §77, 2).
__1. (num igitur) expecting a neg. reply, Lc 18:8; ἆρά γε, At 8:30.
__2. (ergone) in apodosis, expecting an affirm. reply, Gl 2:17 (Bl., l.with; Lft., Ga., in l.; MM, see word).
† (AS)

G0689.def:
Ἀράμ indec. (Heb. רָם),
Aram: Mt 1:3-4, Lc 3:33 (R, txt., WH, Ἀρνεί).†
(AS)

G0691.def:
ἀργέω, -ῶ
(ἀργός), [in LXX: Et 4:24, Ec 12:3 (בָּטֵל), I Et 2:30, Sir.33:27), 2Ma.5:25 * ;]
to be idle; τὸ κρίμα . . . ἀ., lingers (cf. MGr. ἀργά, late: MM, see word): 2Pe 2:3.†
(AS)

G0692.def:
ἀργός, -όν
(in late Gk., incl. NT, -ή, -όν; ἀ- neg., ἔργον) [in LXX: 3Ki.6:7 (מַסָּע), Wis.14:5 15:15, Sir.37:11 38:28 * ;]
inactive, idle: Mt 20:3, 6, 1Tm 5:13, Tt 1:12, 2Pe 1:8. Metaphorical, of things, inactive, ineffective, worthless: ῥῆμα, Mt 12:36; πίστις, Tg 2:20 (see Cremer, 259 f.).†
SYN.: βραδύς, slow; νωθρός, sluggish (Tr., Syn., § civ) (AS)

G0693.def:
ἀργύρεος (see MM, see word), -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν
(ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;]
of silver: At 19:24 (WH, br.), 2Tm 2:20, Ap 9:20.†
(AS)

G0694.def:
ἀργύριον, -ου, τό
(ἄργυρος), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף (Gn 13:2, al.), exc. La 4:1 (כֶּתֶם) ;]
prop., a piece of silver (Lft., Notes, 191); in NT,
__(a) silver: At 3:6 7:16 19:19 20:33, 1Co 3:12, 1Pe 1:18;
__(b) money: Mt 25:18, 27, Mc 14:11, Lc 9:3 19:15, 23 22:5, At 8:20;
__(with) a silver coin: p1., Mt 26:15 27:3-6, 9 28:12, 15, where the value is that of a shekel or tetradrachm; ἀργυρίου μυριάδες πέντε (prob. drachmas; MM, see word), At 19:19.†
(AS)

G0695.def:
ἀργυροκόπος, -ου, ὁ
(ἄργυρος, κόπτω, to beat) [in LXX: Jz 17:4, Jr 6:29 (צָרַף) * ;]
a silversmith: At 19:24 (Plut.; 77., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0696.def:
ἄργυρος, -ου, ὁ
(ἀργός, shining), [in LXX for כֶּסֶף ;]
silver (on its relation to ἀργύριον, see MM, see word): Mt 10:9, At 17:29, Tg 5:5, Ap 18:12.†
(AS)

G0697.def:
Ἄρειος Πάυος (T, Ἄριος Π.), -ου, ὁ
Hill of Pres or Mars, Areopagus; also, the Court of Areopagus, the highest tribunal of Athens: At 17:19, 22.†
(AS)

G0698.def:
Ἀρεοπαγίτης (T, -είτης), -ου, ὁ (see supr.),
a judge of the Court of Areopagus: At 17:34.†
(AS)

G0699.def:
ἀρεσκία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ
(ἀρέσκω), [in LXX (-εία): Pv 31:30 (חֵן) * ;]
pleasing, desire to please: Cl 1:19 In Gk. writers (Arist., Polyb.), most frequently in bad sense, but in π., Inscr., and in Philo, as above (see Deiss., BS, 224; MM, see word; Cremer, 642).†
(AS)
